inlines.v: CLOCK-WORK, noun 1. The machinery and movements of a clock; or that part of the movement which strikes the hours on a bell, in distinction from that part which measures and exhibits the time on the face or dial plate, which is called watch-work. 2. Well adjusted work, with regular movement.
